text: dsh-paperpanel 是面向 DSH Web 的本地资料面板，在右侧抽屉中整理论文、笔记和表格，并提供会话头开关。它扫描配置的资料目录，按论文、数据和笔记分类浏览；可导入文件或文件夹，预览文本与表格，阅读 PDF 和 Word，边读边保存笔记，也能编辑并保存 CSV、TSV 与 Excel。agent 可通过搜索和读取工具查找条目并获取文本或表格内容。适合希望在 DSH Web 中管理本机研究资料并辅助阅读的用户。需要配置本地 libraryRoots 目录；不需要 API key 或外部服务。

dsh-paperpanel adds a local library to DSH Web. It scans folders for papers, notes, and datasets; supports import, text and table previews, PDF/Word reading, saved notes, and spreadsheet editing. Agent tools search and read items. Set libraryRoots; no API key or external service is needed.
我想在 DSH Web 里整理本机的论文和数据文件。
有没有办法边看 PDF 或 Word 文档边记阅读笔记？
I want to browse and edit local spreadsheets from a panel inside DSH Web.
dsh-paperpanel 的功能「本地资料库」：扫描配置目录并按论文、数据和笔记列出文件，可按类型筛选，也能从面板导入文件或整个文件夹后刷新列表。
dsh-paperpanel 的功能「阅读与表格工作台」：打开 PDF/Word 居中阅读并选中文字加入笔记；CSV、TSV 与 Excel 可搜索、排序、分页、编辑和保存。
dsh-paperpanel 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 68 天；提交数 7；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-paperpanel README · dsh-paperpanel：Turn papers (**PDF/Word/TXT/MD**) and data (**CSV/TSV/Excel**) from your local folders into a Zotero-style library,
presented as a **right-side floating drawer in DSH Web** — browse papers on the right, read in a centered window,
jot notes as you read, and edit spreadsheets in place.

dsh-paperpanel README · Features：- **Library panel** (right-side floating drawer via `shell.overlay`; does not occupy the built-in `details` slot):
  item list + type filters (All/Papers/Data/Notes). The **Import** button imports a whole folder or individual files
  (choose a target directory; duplicate names get a timestamp suffix automatically). Hit **Refresh** after importing to see the new items.

dsh-paperpanel README · Features：- **Centered reading**: double-click a PDF/Word item to open it in a centered window with **zoom** (− / + / reset) and a
  **black/white background toggle** (button text flips to keep high contrast against the background).
  - **PDF**: rendered with `pdf.js` (multi-page, selectable text layer)

dsh-paperpanel README · Features：- **Word**: rendered with `docx-preview` (keeps headings/bold/tables); legacy `.doc` prompts you to resave as `.docx`
- **Select-to-note**: select text in a PDF/Word → click **“记笔记 / Take note”** → the quote is appended to your note as a Markdown blockquote
- **Note while reading**: a note panel on the right of the reading window lets you write and save anytime; each item maps to
  a sibling `同名.notes.md` (`<name>.notes.md`) file

dsh-paperpanel README · Features：- **Ask AI to explain**: sends the item path into the host input so the agent can read it with `paperpanel_read` and explain/summarize
- Bundler-free client: `client/paperpanel-client.js` (a single CommonJS file) → `scripts/build-client.mjs` builds `client.js`;
  frontend libs (JSZip/docx-preview/SheetJS/ECharts/pdf.js) are inlined at build time — works fully offline
- Scan/read core: `lib/scan.mjs`, `lib/read.mjs` (pure Node, zero third-party deps)

dsh-paperpanel README · Configure the data folders：Set the scanned root folders under `config.libraryRoots` in `cordis.patch.yml` (the sample points at `samples`).
Drop papers/data into those folders (or subfolders) and press **Refresh** in the drawer, or use the **Import** button to bring files in.

dsh-paperpanel README · Local commands：```bash
npm run build:client          # regenerate client.js after editing client/ sources
```

Start dsh (auto-cleans a stale instance holding port 3080 first, to avoid EADDRINUSE multi-instance conflicts):

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\start-dsh.ps1
```

dsh-paperpanel README · Project layout：```
dsh-paperpanel/
  package.json            # exports / dsh.bundle / dsh.client
  cordis.patch.yml        # bundle insert declaration (default libraryRoots)
  index.mjs               # Node half: HTTP routes + agent tools paperpanel_search / paperpanel_read

dsh-paperpanel README · Backend API (same-origin fetch, no token needed)：- `GET /paperpanel/api/roots` → `{ ok, roots }`
- `GET /paperpanel/api/manifest` → `{ ok, scannedAt, roots, itemCount, items[] }`
- `GET /paperpanel/api/preview?path=…` → text preview
- `GET /paperpanel/api/file?path=…` → raw file (used by PDF/Word rendering and the spreadsheet workbench)
- `POST /paperpanel/api/import?name=…&dir=…` → import a file into a data folder (allow-listed)
- `POST /paperpanel/api/save` → `{ path, content, encoding }` writes the file back (backs up the original to `.bak` first)
- `GET/POST /paperpanel/api/note?path=…` → read/save the item's `.notes.md` note
section: Backend API (same-origin fetch, no token needed)

dsh-paperpanel README · Agent tools：- `paperpanel_search`: search the catalog by title/path keyword or type.
- `paperpanel_read`: read an item's content (text body / CSV headers+rows / PDF metadata).

dsh-paperpanel README · Listing in the plugin marketplace：To appear in DSH's plugin marketplace (dshmarket), submit to the curated list
[awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin): add an entry
(plugin name, npm package, GitHub repo, description, screenshots, …); the site and marketplace pick it up
automatically, usually within a day. The marketplace only installs sources on the curated list — anything
else must be installed manually with `dsh plugin add`.

dsh-paperpanel README · Notes：- The right-hand `details` slot is a single seat and this plugin deliberately does not occupy it; it uses
  `shell.overlay` (the official additive overlay seat) instead.
- The drawer is root-scoped; `inputActions` are bridged in through the session-header button — **Ask AI to explain**
  is disabled when there is no active session.
- Save/note/import all do a root-folder allow-list check; spreadsheet saves back up the original to `原文件.bak`.
- `*.notes.md` note files are excluded from scanning so they never pollute the catalog.
- No `dsh.engines.dsh` is declared, so it stays compatible across dsh versions and never breaks boot on a version mismatch.
